resources.string: Off. Enable temporarily to send Galaxunil events to your private dashboard.

Enter the 4-digit code within 2 minutes. Stored and new Galaxunil logs will be sent to your private dashboard for up to 15 minutes. Logs may contain addresses, file paths, and guest app output. Other Android apps, screenshots, and microphone or camera data are not collected.
